Privacy policy

This policy explains what data Brightpath Analytics holds, why we hold it, and how to ask for a copy or a deletion. It was last reviewed on 2 June 2026.

What we collect

We collect the inventory and transaction feeds you send us, plus the name and work email of each user on your account.

How long we keep it

Feed data is retained for 36 months and then deleted. Account records are deleted 90 days after an account closes.

How to make a request

Email privacy@brightpath-analytics.example. We respond within 30 days.
